evals.name: wrapper-upstream-latest
evals.prompt: descheduler 래퍼 차트 업스트림 최신 버전으로 범프해줘
evals.expected_output: Queries the registry for the latest descheduler chart version before editing; bumps dependencies version, syncs appVersion to upstream appVersion, and handles the wrapper version as past bumps did (mirror upstream, keep fixed, or minor); carries every hunk of the upstream values diff between old and new versions to its upstream position with comments verbatim and keeps local overrides; regenerates Chart.lock only if tracked; touches nothing else; ships it on a new bump branch with a commit in the repo's git log convention and an MR whose description ends with one release notes details block.

evals.name: image-only-bump
evals.expected_output: Verifies nginx:1.27.5 exists in the registry (e.g. crane digest) before editing; changes appVersion and the explicit image tag only; chart version unchanged; comments and key order preserved; environment override files untouched; commit holds only that chart's paths and the MR follows git-ship conventions.

evals.name: missing-version-abort
evals.expected_output: Queries the argo-cd chart registry, finds 9.99.0 does not exist, makes no file edits, no commit, no MR, and reports the latest available argo-cd chart version.

evals.name: wrapper-pinned-image-tag
evals.expected_output: Verifies mimir-distributed 6.2.1 exists; bumps dependencies version and appVersion; notices values.yaml pins image.tag to the old appVersion and moves it to the new appVersion after confirming the tag exists in the registry the values point at; carries the upstream values diff between 6.2.0 and 6.2.1 with comments verbatim, rewriting new image repositories to the repo registry proxy convention; keeps the wrapper version fixed when earlier bumps left it unchanged; helm template shows the new chart label and image tag; ships with an MR carrying the release notes details block.

evals.name: single-env-bump-with-mr
evals.prompt: shared kiali-operator 차트 최신 버전으로 범프하고 MR 올려줘
evals.expected_output: Verifies the latest kiali-operator chart version; bumps dependency, appVersion and the helm show values comment in the shared environment; moves every pinned tag that equals the old version (operator image tag and the Kiali server version in the CR) to the new version after checking the tags exist in the registry the values point at; updates the repo's chart version inventory row; validates with helm template; creates a branch from the default branch, commits only the chart paths and inventory row with sign-off, pushes with upstream tracking, and opens an MR whose short description ends with one release notes details block with one bold subheading per release in the range and plain (#PR) references and no github.com links.
assertions: Verified the target kiali-operator chart version exists in the registry before editing
Moved every pinned tag equal to the old version (operator image tag and CR server version) to the new version
Updated the repo's chart version inventory row (README table) in the same commit
Created a new branch (not the default branch) and committed only kiali-operator chart paths plus the inventory row
Commit message has a Signed-off-by trailer and no Co-Authored-By or tool attribution
Prepared push with upstream tracking (git push -u origin <branch>) and an MR create command targeting the default branch
MR description uses the repo's MR section convention (진행배경, 변경사항, 기타사항)
MR description ends with exactly one release notes <details> block
Release notes have one bold subheading per release after the old version up to the new one, oldest first, all inside the single <details> block
Release notes contain no github.com links and reference PRs as plain (#number) text

evals.name: multi-env-bump-default-ship
evals.prompt: keda 전환경 차트 2.21.0 으로 범프 진행
evals.expected_output: Verifies keda 2.21.0 exists; bumps every environment directory that has its own keda Chart.yaml; carries the upstream values diff to each environment while keeping per-environment overrides; validates helm template per environment; ships by default without being asked for an MR: one branch, one commit with only keda paths, push, MR with one release notes details block.
assertions: Verified keda chart 2.21.0 exists before editing
Bumped every environment directory that has a keda Chart.yaml
Per-environment overrides (tolerations, affinity values) are preserved
Ran helm template or equivalent render validation for the bumped charts
Proceeded to ship (branch, commit, push, MR) without the user explicitly asking for an MR
Updated the repo's chart version inventory row (README table) in the same commit
Commit includes only keda chart paths plus the inventory row
MR description ends with exactly one release notes <details> block
Release notes have one bold subheading per release in the range inside the single <details> block
Release notes have no github.com links and use plain (#number) PR references

evals.name: missing-version-abort-with-mr
evals.prompt: argo-rollouts 차트 9.99.0 으로 범프하고 MR 올려줘
evals.expected_output: Queries the argo-rollouts chart registry, finds 9.99.0 does not exist, makes no file edits, creates no branch, commit, push or MR, and reports the latest available argo-rollouts chart version.
assertions: Queried the argo-rollouts chart registry for 9.99.0
Made no file edits
Created no branch, commit, push or MR
Reported the latest available argo-rollouts chart version
